objective: Minimum worst-case total readings; then minimum worst-case declared acquisition cost among all finite adaptive policies within that reading bound. Action source order breaks exact cost ties. No prior probabilities or expected-cost claim.

assumptions.hypotheses: 2–5 finite declared scalar-output linear dynamical laws with 1–5 latent coordinates and 1–4 input channels
assumptions.experimentCatalogue: 1–8 repeatable, independently prescribed complete control/readout bundles, 2–10 control ticks and 1–8 distinct sorted reading ticks per experiment
assumptions.nuisance: One persistent true law; independently arbitrary unknown initial state and any componentwise bounded error vector in each experiment. No hidden cross-round constraints or action-availability changes.
assumptions.cost: Nonnegative integer actuation cost and positive integer reading cost, each at most 1000000000; no measured monetary or actuation-cost calibration.
assumptions.maxTotalReadings: 1–32; every guaranteed policy can be made strictly reduce the surviving subset, so at most four positive-length rounds are needed.
assumptions.workLimit: 100–50000, shared exact-LP starts, tableau row updates, mask traversal, static subsets and adaptive-state action checks. Exhaustion returns no chosen optimal policy. No assertion or budget will be relaxed after observing qualification results.
assumptions.closedErrors: A common tube radius equal to epsilon is feasible overlap. Strictly greater radius rules out a joint survivor set.

mathematicalAcceptance: Every common-tube radius supplies exact primal initial states and common readings, plus a dual annihilator with total L1 norm at most1 and equal forcing lower bound.
All feasible survivor intersections are evaluated, including the three-line counterexample where pairwise overlaps do not imply a common intersection.
Maximal feasible intersections are possible exact survivor sets; monotonicity under subset inclusion permits their use in the Bellman worst branch.
Whole-current-set overlap permits an adversary to retain all candidates; nonnegative cost makes such actions unnecessary for any finite worst-case optimum.
C(S,B)=min_a cost(a)+max_T C(T,B-readings(a)); singleton cost0, infeasible state infinity. The remaining budget is retained, including the five-law slack counterexample.
The exact minimal static subset comparator and the independent Fraction/SciPy-derived policy agree with all14 analytic anchors and all36 prospectively generated source courses.

SciPy1.14.1 with NumPy1.26.4 proposes bases at1e-9 feasibility tolerances; Fraction primal/dual equality, rather than numerical tolerance, certifies every independent radius and closed intersection decision.
Outcomes are evaluated only after exact frozen policy replay, never supplied to policy synthesis. Every source, policy, action, preceding round and original observation byte identity is bound.

Missing complete-bundle readings, changed outcomes, reordered rounds, altered branches, wrong controls, cross-source reuse, ambiguous and zero-survivor outcomes are handled explicitly. No fabricated winner or silent replan.

baseline.algorithm: Frozen exhaustive best-static catalogue subset reference using shipped1b53125 exact pairwise geometry. This is a newly frozen comparator, not an earlier shipped adaptive solver.
baseline.purpose: Measure guaranteed acquisition budgets and the computation tradeoff of adaptive planning on identical source catalogues; no semantic-output identity or unconditional speedup is presumed.
baseline.coldABBA: 3rounds×ABBA, fresh Node22.23.4 processes, --max-old-space-size=1536, 3repetitions, both anchor and fixed12-case cohort, wall and maxRSS. No warm/debug comparison.

receiving.syntheticAcquisition: Independent recurrence, unknown initial states and bounded errors; persistent law hidden from planner. An independent peer freezes a separate private challenge before candidate code. Every episode's action/readout transcript and total cost is retained.
receiving.negativeControls: No actuation, identical hypotheses, exact noise contact, nonlinear/out-of-family supplied readings, forged bindings, work exhaustion. Existing pinned Nullgarden negative controls continue to run.
receiving.product: Same actual Hidden-state entry point, plan/readout separation, inspectable current and potential next experiments, original bytes, restart/reopen/CLI notebook replay, source-only labels, keyboard, reduced motion, desktop1920 and narrow320/390 pixels.
receiving.regression: All existing scientific and actual-browser gates, and literal prior fixed/menu/binary/joint notebook replay. Full existing obligations remain.
receiving.release: Self-merge qualified source; existing official package script; fresh merged-main archive file hashes and browser/CLI replay receiving. Do not commit media, logs or STATUS.md.

scope: Finite declared linear-family adaptive identification under the stated fresh-nuisance model. It does not learn the law family, calibrate errors, actuate hardware or establish unfamiliar real-world/ARC mechanism discovery. The broad research task stays open.
